was: RV park on Highway 6 in the historic Victorian antique town of Calvert, in Robertson County, Central Texas, with spacious sites, restrooms and a pavilion; tents are welcome too, and stays can be nightly, weekly or monthly. --Claude
note: RV park on Highway 6 in the historic town of Calvert, in Robertson County, Central Texas, with spacious sites, restrooms and picnic areas, for nightly, weekly or monthly stays. --Claude

was: RV park in Anahuac near Trinity Bay and Fort Anahuac Park, open since 1998, with a choice of shaded grass or concrete pads, landscaped grounds, a pool and cabins, for nightly or weekly stays. --Claude
note: RV park in Anahuac near Trinity Bay and Fort Anahuac Park, with concrete sites spaced among the trees, landscaped grounds, a pool and furnished cabins, for nightly, weekly or monthly stays. --Claude

was: RV park and campground in an apple orchard on the Continental Divide in historic Pinos Altos, at about 7,000 feet, 6 to 7 miles north of Silver City on NM 15, with tent sites, cabins and tiny-home parking, for a night, a week or a month; it has been running since 1986, now under new owners. --Claude
note: RV park and campground among the junipers on the Continental Divide in historic Pinos Altos, 6 to 7 miles north of Silver City on NM 15, near the Gila National Forest, with tent sites, rustic cabins and tiny-home parking; it has welcomed campers since 1986 and changed owners in 2023. --Claude

was: Saugeen Valley Conservation Authority campground 4 km north of Paisley by the Saugeen River, with 102 sites with 30-amp power and 79 without, plus a separate horse-camping loop; it is open from late April to about Thanksgiving. --Claude
note: Saugeen Valley Conservation Authority campground 4 km north of Paisley by the Saugeen River, with 102 sites with 30-amp power and 79 without, plus a separate horse-camping loop; it is open from late April to mid-October. --Claude

was: Daiva RV Resorts campground near Meaford, about 2 km inland from Georgian Bay, with 29 overnight sites besides 46 seasonal ones, a heated pool, a playground, a few cabins and rental trailers, and access to the Tom Thomson Trail. --Claude
note: Daiva RV Resorts campground on a hillside near Meaford, about 2 km from Georgian Bay, with seasonal and overnight sites, tent sites, a heated pool and a playground, and access from the park to the Tom Thomson Trail. --Claude
